CharacterVotes.title: CharacterVotes
CharacterVotes.description: Stores the accumulated vote count for a specific fictional chatbot character.

characterId.description: Unique identifier matching the character ID in characters.ts.

votes.description: Total number of votes accumulated for this character.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this vote record was last updated.

BlogPost.title: BlogPost
BlogPost.description: An individual blog post or diary entry written anonymously.

id.description: Unique identifier for the blog post.

author.description: Author of the blog post, usually 'Người ẩn danh' or 'Khách vãng lai'.

content.description: The main content of the post.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the post was created.

userId.description: UID of the user who authored the post.

character.description: Character the post is sent to.

category.description: Category: BLOG, DIARY, or TÂM SỰ.

reactedUsers.description: List of user UIDs who reacted to this post.

image_url.description: Optional direct URL to an image for this post.

audio_url.description: Optional direct URL to an MP3 audio file for background music.

GalleryPost.title: GalleryPost
GalleryPost.description: An image or drawing posted by a user to the gallery.

id.description: Unique identifier for the gallery post.

image_url.description: The direct URL of the shared drawing or image.

title.description: The title of the drawing or artwork.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the post was created.

user_id.description: UID of the user who posted this artwork.

author.description: The display name or email of the author.

BlogComment.title: BlogComment
BlogComment.description: A comment left under an anonymous blog post.

author.description: Nickname of the commentator or 'Người ẩn danh'.

createdAt.description: Epoch timestamp of when the comment was created.

userId.description: UID of the user who made the comment.

votes/{characterId}.description: Collection where each document represents the voting stats for a single character.

blog_posts/{postId}.description: Collection of all anonymous blog posts and diaries.

blog_posts/{postId}/comments/{commentId}.description: Sub-collection of comments made under a specific blog post.

gallery_posts/{postId}.description: Collection of gallery images posted by users.
